description: I hear Mountaineer Stormpike is looking for a runner.  Someone to do a little traveling for him.  How about it?  Are you the <race> for the job?
If so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.
completion: That's right. I have a task that I can't do while I'm guarding. In fact, it'll take you far from Loch Modan.
